reviews.title: App crashes
reviews.text: App crashes a lot and doesn't work properly. Super annoying when you're just trying to order your pet's things without busting out the laptop.

reviews.title: AUTOSHIP KEEPS PUTTING STUFF I BUY IN STORE INTO MY CART!
reviews.text:
I am so frustrated with this app!
Each time I go into the store and make a purchase, it automatically goes into “autoship”!
I have manually gone in and deleted 80+ items in my cart that were designated “AUTOSHIP” and I have had to do it multiple times!!
FIX THIS RIDICULOUS PROBLEM OR I’M SWITCHING TO PETCO BECAUSE I HAVE NEVER HAD TO DEAL WITH THIS ON MY PETCO APP

reviews.title: Tried to pay for training
reviews.text: I went through several steps to set up training for my puppy & the payment button wouldn’t work. I assume my vpn is blocking it but still- I’m now going to find an independent trainer website that doesn’t block me because I like my privacy.

reviews.title: This app performs so terribly I HAVE to leave a review I’d give zero stars if I could
reviews.text: PLEASE fix this pathetic excuse for an app. I can’t even get an order placed because adding and updating my cart makes the entire app freeze time and time again -A joke.

reviews.title: Consistent payment issues
reviews.text: App keeps taking my money but not placing my order. I have to consistently wait for the transaction to dispute and try again if I want to place an order. Not worth it anymore only doing in store shopping.

reviews.title: WORST APP EVER
reviews.text: This is the worst app I have ever used. I don’t even know why they offer updates because nothing changes. I purchase a lot of items and it takes over an hour because I’m constantly having to close the app and go back in to manually add a single item at a time. Even when I buy a small amount of items, it still takes a long time and buffers until again, you have to exit out of the app and restart it. To add something to your cart takes forever because their server is so slow. And no matter how many negative reviews they get about this same thing, they do not fix the problem

reviews.title: Worthless to Me
reviews.text: Maybe a year ago I would have given this 4 stars. But at some point it forgot all of my pets. It’s useless to me now. I would have to readd my pets to use it for scheduling I ised to count on it for the doggie day camp feature. At this point I have to get to my laptop to use the web site to perform this action. I’m signed in on the app. Where’s my data?

reviews.title: Canceled order
reviews.text: What’s the point of having a promo code if you’re going to cancel orders. What a disappointment. Chewy has never canceled any orders when using promo codes

reviews.title: App Updates
reviews.text: For as many updates there are to this app you figure it would work top notch. Lately it’s been freezing up when adding items to the cart or updating items in the cart. I have to constantly close the app in the middle of ordering or just to check out.

reviews.title: Can’t sign in can’t search anything
reviews.text:
It’s been about six months since they updated the app, June 20, 2026, ever since then I’ve been unable to sign in. When I type in my username and password, I get a screen that just spins and spins and spins. I’ve set it up overnight and it was still spinning in the morning.  
PetSmart fix your app you are slacking hard. 
I would give you zero stars if I could, since it is effectively unusable.

reviews.title: Making people dependent on apps
reviews.text: I go to my PetSmart store. I don’t shop at it online because it’s very convenient to me to go to the store. However, while I was checking out today, the clerk said that I would get a $10 credit (as I had spent more than $50) toward future purchases if I had the app on my phone. I don’t. As a result, I was only going to get the two-dollar credit. Screw you, PetSmart. I’ve got enough apps on my phone. In the past, I’ve been giving those two dollar credits back to your charity efforts, but maybe I’ll rethink that from now on.

reviews.title: Runs terrible on iPhone 13 Pro Max
reviews.text: Dosent load items,lags at checkout,gets stuck when putting in information. Overall terrible IT team running the app can even bother to optimize if for older ios compared to petco app this is a complete joke and embarrassment do better you have the resources for it.

reviews.title: Scammed
reviews.text: Ordered a $33 enclosure and was told my card had insufficient funds when i had $200 some in that account so I was like maybe something’s wrong with my card I used my boyfriends card just for his card to be charged $33 for the enclosure and $200 from georgia power co and 2 $50 payments from city of new york (we live in iowa) so wouldn’t let me pay with my card because I didn’t have enough money to pull for the scam I guess. Don’t order anything from this app or online it apparently has been hacked for some time and nothing has been done about it

reviews.title: Errors
reviews.text: Many codes do not work. Not well tested!

reviews.title: Horrible Customer Service (Online Order Review)
reviews.text: Placed an online order. Set to be delivered before 5 PM (PT). App showed driver never leaving the store, despite the app updates saying he was “on the way to the store” or “on his way to you with many deliveries”. 45 minutes past the latest delivery time, I called the driver - no response.  When I called the “team member” to get an update on my delivery, I was told that the driver has my order but had a lot of deliveries and if I don’t receive by this evening, I could call the next day to get a refund.  I said, if he has my delivery, why can’t I get my order today? Turns out, driver was lazy and hadn’t been keeping up with his own tracking to update the app. But the team member didn’t tell me accurate information either.  Done with this company.

reviews.title: Ridiculous
reviews.text: You have the worst app I’ve ever seen. It never works, it takes forever to load anything and I have every reason to believe you don’t care because you never fix the stupid thing. It’s as good as your same day delivery option. Between your app, your store, your pitiful delivery service aka DoorDash you’ve made me hate everything PetSmart. I wish Chewy had real stores here because I would never shop your pathetic store again. UPDATE: I’ve officially had enough with the customer service and the app. I have cancelled my last order and I’m in the process of deleting my account granted you seem to be making that even impossible to do for whatever reasons you have. So congrats there’s room for a different VIPP bc this one is gone for good!

reviews.title: Useless!
reviews.text: The app glitches CONSTANTLY!  I can't order through it anymore because it freezes-ip!  I've turned my phone on/off, closed the app/relaunched REPEATEDLY... CANNOT PLACE AN ORDER!  Fix it already!!

reviews.title: Please upgrade the app
reviews.text: I hoped to use PetSmart instead of a competitor for canned food autoship, but found the PetSmart app impossible to use. Looking for a specific product, when I finally was able to get to the correct brand, none of the options gave the actual name of the product (Funk in The Trunk). It gives “grain free, pate” for various styles, with can pictures so small the name is difficult to see.  Search for Funk, it does not come up. Use the “go back” arrow, it takes you all the way back to the main menu.  I gave up, went back to the competitor site, which is remarkably easy to use.

reviews.title: Sucks
reviews.text: Get it right before using it

reviews.title: Do not use this app
reviews.text: App will debit your account and then give you an error message saying that an issue occurred and your order has not been placed. It takes days to get your money back. Absolute ripoff.

reviews.title: Glitching all the time
reviews.text: The app is always glitching and very difficult ti check out.

reviews.title: Prices
reviews.text: Your prices are not the same online as they are in the groomers salon. Your online ad doesn’t mention a different ad on for weekends and why is the customer charged for the shampoo you are using for your salon? I was charged 10.00 extra for the shampoo and I was charged 6.00 for weekend fee for the Bath/Brush.

reviews.title: So so
reviews.text: App is just ehhh when it works.     Points don’t automatically apply and payment fails most of the time. Why have an app if it rarely works!

reviews.title: Unable to checkout with Apple Pay
reviews.text: Payment Failed error received consistently. App is up to date  to v15.12.0. Uninstalled and reinstalled. Card information in AP is correct (purchased something with it earlier today so it’s not my AP account). Called CS and advised the issue which they said they’d note. Not willing to save my CC details directly in app. Please fix ASAP.

reviews.title: Unexpected Error
reviews.text: Title and keeps happening can you make an app with more consistency and able to work all the and not when you feel like it

reviews.title: The WORST app ever
reviews.text: Stuff shows in stock, you add it to your cart, you add something else to the cart, then it says out of stock, then you look on the product page and it says In Stock. The app freezes up continuously making buying anything damn near impossible. And why can’t you order various delivery methods (curbside, delivery, and shipping) in one order? Target figured out how to do this a long time ago. Fix the damn app.

reviews.title: Rewards/Checkout
reviews.text:
If you applied the rewards at the checkout, you have to checkout right away or else if you do it later then the rewards is gone. 

Also can’t check out if you use Apple Pay, it will keep saying update the address after doing so a couple times. Use a card if you do wanna be able to buy stuffs.

reviews.title: Constantly freezing on the cart page
reviews.text: I cannot use this app. Every single time I open up my cart the entire app freezes and I have to close it. It’s incredibly frustrating. I want to use my offers but can’t because of this.

reviews.title: Dreadful
reviews.text: No communication, no updates, minimal visibility into the order process. And you’ll respond in 2-3 days?!?!

reviews.title: the app never works
reviews.text: anytime I try to go on the app and place an order for same-day delivery. It never works. I always have to go to the website in order to place my order and it’s super annoying because the app is supposed to be convenient.

reviews.title: Can’t place order
reviews.text: I keep getting an error message when trying to place an order through the app. No problem logging into the website and placing the order directly from there. Not sure what’s up with the app or why I get an error, but unless it’s fixed it’s useless to me.

reviews.title: Terrible app and website
reviews.text: The app never functions correctly. The website works sometimes. Apple pay is available on the app but will not let the transaction go through. The app does not allow spaces when adding your name to the billing address. Both the website and app need attention from real web and app developers. Whoever they are using now aren’t doing it well. This company has more than enough money to hire an actual website and app staff. Shameful

reviews.title: Bugs when checking out
reviews.text: It seems like there are always bug on this app when trying to buy stuff. It keeps asking for my address even though my address is correct and entered

reviews.title: Glitchy
reviews.text: This app is so difficult to use. I try to put something in my cart and it just spins and spins. Drives me crazy - especially when I can’t get to the store and really need more cat food

reviews.title: Glitchy, slow, terrible
reviews.text: The app constantly freezes when you search, add an item, change a quantity…ANYTHING. I have to close it and reopen it over and over again just to add items to my order. Incredibly frustrating.

reviews.title: Update Broke App
reviews.text:
I can no longer activate treat rewards, which is ridiculous to be something I’d have to do… why not just automatically apply applicable rewards.

Beyond that pages don’t even load content.

Worse is I go onto mobile version of website and it just pushes you back to the app.

What a terrible experience.

reviews.title: The worst app
reviews.text:
You can’t edit pet information or add a new pet. It makes you put in all these details and then when you click “Save”, nothing. And this has been a problem for over THREE YEARS!! They know it’s a problem and refuse to do anything. 

Not to mention, if you have multiple emails associated with your account, you apparently have to call the corporate freaking office to get them removed. You can’t just delete an account or email, regardless if you use the app, the website, or go in the store. 

I don’t know what updates they keep making us do through the App Store or what “bug fixes” they’re taking about cause it’s been the same POS app for years and nothing has changed. Not sure who works for their App development or UX/UI team, but they’re all severely overpaid.

reviews.title: Autoship problem
reviews.text: Unable to cancel an autoship once it begins processing.   Also no way to cancel using this app ALL future autoship.  Tried the only phone number but no 24/7 support.

reviews.title: Glitch app
reviews.text: Worst experience ever confirmed new address prior to ordering items still shipped to old address even after updating address book

reviews.title: What Happened?
reviews.text: The app no longer allows me shop and search for items. This has been happening for over a week.

reviews.title: Garbage
reviews.text: This app is and always has been glitchy AF.  No update has ever improved it.  Works maybe 1 out of every 10 times I try to use it.

reviews.title: App doesn't update
reviews.text: App is broke and they don't care.  I pushed out the date to no avail

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: Now my kids want a snake instead a kitty so I tried to remove to cat stuff in the cart but I does not remove

reviews.title: Poor app
reviews.text: Difficult to use to find where to change the password after you allowed my password to be compromised.

reviews.title: Shopping on app
reviews.text: The shopping feature on the app leaves a lot to be desired. When searching for things that I know are available for purchase through the app, it will often say that it doesn’t exist and when I’m actually able to get to the checkout there’s inevitably some kind of issue on their end with payment or address or pricing. I always leave the app frustrated even when I can get what I was looking for because it was such a pain to get there.

reviews.title: Awful
reviews.text: So inconsistent and difficult to use! They offer discounts but refuse to apply them at checkout. It’s largely a waste of time! If I could get the Hills science elsewhere I would

reviews.title: Can’t book an appointment
reviews.text: Seriously PetSmart.  You have an online booking process that you aren’t able to access. Fix this please!! It hasn’t been working for 72 hours. Jesus

reviews.title: Update ruined site!
reviews.text:
I have taken all three of my dogs to Petsmart for years. Zoe has been grooming them for several years. All of a sudden with the most recent update, all my pets are out of the system. When I try to ADD them, it says they’re already on the system. WHERE ARE THEY?
Please correct this ERROR! I have to CALL the Martinsville location to book an appt now, and it’s not convenient!
ADD MY PETS BACK INTO MY ACCOUNT!

reviews.title: Doesn’t work!
reviews.text: Won’t allow me to make a purchase. Keeps telling me to update my address, even though it’s correct. Terrible app.

reviews.title: Glitchy-dropped all my dogs
reviews.text: I can’t book a grooming appointment because the app dropped all of my dogs and won’t let me add them because they’re already on my profile? How does that work?

reviews.title: They broke the app!
reviews.text: App used to work fine.  You were able to book appointments no problem.  You can no longer book appointments and it’s been like this for 2 months.  You are hurting the business, fix this asap!!!

reviews.title: App problem
reviews.text: PetSmart Whenever I try to book a pet grooming appointment for my dog, the system fails or blocks the request, even though my app is fully updated and my account is in good standing. There appears to be a restriction or flag on my profile preventing me from scheduling. Please check my account status and lift this restriction so I can book grooming services.

reviews.title: i hate petsmart so much.
reviews.text: returns are so difficult, the basking rock i ordered for my bearded dragon came broken mind you i paid 50 dollars for it because i wanted it that bad. i went on the app to see how i can return it or get a replacement and found out i have to call and send it back but if i did it that way they wouldn’t fully refund me and they’d take my money to send it back with no replacement?? my only other option is bringing it into a store but i ordered this because i cant drive, i live in a small town and there’s no petsmarts nearby so i guess im just out 50 dollars.

reviews.title: DOES NOT WORK
reviews.text: App is slow , doesn’t add anything to my cart and always logs me out

reviews.title: Store is great - app is not
reviews.text: App won’t let me schedule grooming appointments - I have to call the store to schedule. It used to work great- then changed to allow one but not both and now it doesn’t have either pet listed but when I put their info in- it says I already have that pet …but I can’t access it! Pointless app!

reviews.title: Payments
reviews.text: Hard to order online with app. Have to delete and work thru website and REENTER payment method and card info each time. Extremely frustrating.

reviews.title: Awful app
reviews.text: Constantly crashes and freezes.

reviews.title: The worst app
reviews.text: This app & their website hardly EVER work. I have pretty much switched to Petco exclusively because their online systems are better. I am disabled & I am not able to go to the store in person so I rely on delivery/online.

reviews.title: Can’t book grooming appointment
reviews.text: I use this app for 5 years now to book grooming appointments for 1 dog. Since last appointment, the app must have updated because I can no longer book appointment while signed into my account. There is a section to rebook past appointment, but it wants me to add pet. I re-add pet and it says pet already exists. There is no way to book appointment while signed into to this app. The only reason I use this app. I will probably bring my pet to a local groomer.

reviews.title: No funciona
reviews.text: La aplicación no funciona correctamente para realizar compras ni para consultar el historial de compras. En la práctica, casi todo tienes que hacerlo a través de la página web, lo que hace que la aplicación pierda completamente su utilidad. No vale la pena descargarla.

reviews.title: Are you joking?
reviews.text:
How this app gets a 4 is beyond me unless someone is pumping 5 star reviews. It is completely hot garbage that never works properly. 

Is someone totally vibe coding who has no idea about how to integrate systems and thoroughly test?  

Only reason I use PetSmart at all is I like my dog’s groomer. 

This app ain’t smart.

reviews.title: 3rd party TRASH
reviews.text: They use Roadie as a delivery service in my area and they just cost me an entire shipment of prescription food for my cat. The driver dropped it off at my neighborhood’s office instead of the CLEARLY PRINTED house address.

reviews.title: New update
reviews.text: It says my pet already exists but is not anywhere for me to select and wants me to add a new pet. Cannot schedule a grooming appointment

reviews.title: Makes the customer do all the work
reviews.text: Quite simply, why create an app where you have to check in every time you visit the store?  Seems like its only purpose is to rely on customers not doing that. The “savings” they promise never exist.

reviews.title: Log In Issue
reviews.text: After multiple purchase attempts, I had to use a browser to buy something. I tried reinstalling the app. I tried logging out and back in to my account. Now the app won’t log into my account at all. Browser login still works fine.

reviews.title: App used to be great
reviews.text: Recent updates removed the ability to use the animals under your profile for grooming appointment requests. I absolutely refuse to enter all of that information for each dog each time. There is also no easily found way to contact them about it the app, only the website. Fix that and I’ll update my review.

reviews.title: Rebook Last Grooming Appointment Fails
reviews.text: So I’ve been using this App for several years. It’s never been great but has some benefits. I primarily use it for booking my dogs grooming appointments. I like the option to rebook the last appointment but it just hangs and never proceeds on iOS. Please fix this as it will save users a lot of time!

reviews.title: Completely Unuseable
reviews.text: I have used the petsmart app for a few years and it is alright for most things. Recently, however, I have been completely unable to add items to my cart, change quantities of things in my cart, or add a new payment method without the entire app crashing. I have been unable to order anything. Extremely frustrating.

reviews.title: App sucks
reviews.text: Can never add a pet can never pay your bill online.  The app absolutely sucks.

reviews.title: Shopping cart not working
reviews.text: Please get the shopping cart to show as i tried several times to place order on the app and the cart just cannot load

reviews.title: Terrible User Experience
reviews.text: The app is slow. I have good connection and the latest iPhone. I try to make an appt for my doggo’s grooming and it doesn’t recognize his saved information. I try to re-enter and say that his information is already in the system, but I don’t see. I’m force to call to make the appt as there is no way to proceed.

reviews.title: Your website
reviews.text: Dis functional

reviews.title: Unusable
reviews.text: I'm trying to book a grooming appointment and the app won't load my pet going through the services and then says she already exists when I try and add her. I go to try through the package deal and it just keeps a loading page.

reviews.title: App crashes frequently
reviews.text: No matter how many updates this app gets it still is terrible. I hate it and if there were a word worse than hate to say I would. I dread every time I open the app. It crashes most particularly during the checkout process but it will even crash when I’m trying to add items to my cart or edit them. It can take me hours to get a payment to go through after repeated attempts. At least one time I missed the last delivery window for the day because I couldn’t get my payment to process through PayPal.  I only use this app because I feel i have no choice at times because of time constraints in my life. I find it frustrating because by the time I’ve gotten an order through I have wasted enough time I probably could have just gone into the store and made my purchases. I do like the rewards system and that is a positive.

reviews.title: Please update STAT
reviews.text: There are so many issues. At times, the search function doesn’t work. Or it takes forever to put an item in the cart. At times, it won’t take your payment. I fought with the app for an entire week just to get items in the cart with the Save20 deal only for the app to refuse to checkout. It just kept buffering. Finally after missing the deal and desperately needing the items, I went to the website. However, it made me change the method of delivery… so I did. It wouldn’t allow me to do same day delivery, I could only pick up. However, it then routed everything to NJ although it’s set at a store in Maryland. The cost of the order went up $18 between the app and the website. Not because of a promo, I missed that but because the website had everything priced differently. I escalated to the store manager upon pickup to which she told me the SAVE20 promotion hand y worked for her either. When I buy, I’m doing a 3mo restock for 4 pets so it’s costly and I need coupons and savings just to afford them. Sadly, I missed out AND had to pay out $18 more than the base price. Please fix the glitches and incongruence. It’s really frustrating.

reviews.title: Honestly consistently the most Un-Userfriendly app on my phone. Something simple made difficult.
reviews.text: One Consistently needs to call to ask for help. And it’s not just that the app is not intuitive. I  couldn’t even come close to guessing how many hours have been wasted from a company perspective AND user perspective in simply trying to place an order; 1) Place the order stays greyed out even when everything is complete and the app shows nothing is causing an error. 2) tried to order two types of a particular dog food both under same prescription. App will not complete the order called and were told two separate orders needed to be placed since it’s two different items. Of course the app doesn’t tell you why it will let you proceed but when calling in they finally figure it out. 3) can’t delete one of the items from the app to be able to do one at a time agent needs to delete both for you and you start over. 4) when searching Hills prescription diet dog food nothing comes up frequently but they have it 🤷🏽.  This is just today’s order no time to add in all the challenges hope they fix the app one day.

reviews.title: App does not work
reviews.text: I am not a person who normally submits reviews. Doesn’t matter how much I like the company or the app, I just don’t do it.… Unless, the app really infuriates me. And here I am. It doesn’t matter what I try to do, the app lags horribly or it just won’t respond. Also, it won’t allow for multiple methods to receive your items. And when it gives you that error, it won’t let you correct it in the cart. The circle spins and spins and nothing ever comes of it. I have tried closing the app and reopening it and that does not work. More often than not I have to actually shut my phone off and restart it and order for it to sometimes start working again. PetSmart really should give coupons to their app users for the level of frustration the app can give.
